-- Shut Up, Sherlock (30014)
INSERT INTO newsTags (newsId, tagId)
SELECT 30014, id FROM tags WHERE slug IN ('reviews-press', 'regional-theatre')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM newsTags WHERE newsId = 30014 AND tagId = tags.id);
